sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.summary: This policy sets the rules for business travel, accommodation, daily allowances and the reimbursement of expenses.
sections.text: This policy sets the rules for business travel, accommodation, daily allowances and the reimbursement of expenses. It applies to all employees. Expenses must be submitted in the Expense portal within 30 days of the end of the trip; claims submitted after 60 days are not reimbursed.

Bookings made less than 7 days ahead need the approval of the employee's manager with a reason. The lowest logical fare within 2 hours of the preferred departure time must be chosen.

Tier 2 cities: Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Coimbatore, Nagpur, Kochi, Indore and other state capitals. Staying with friends or relatives instead of a hotel is allowed and is compensated with a flat INR 1,000 per night.

sections.title: 5. Daily allowance (per diem)
sections.summary: The daily allowance covers meals, local conveyance within the city and incidentals.
sections.text: The daily allowance covers meals, local conveyance within the city and incidentals. Grade Domestic (INR per day) International (USD per day) G1 800 50 G2 1,200 70 G3 1,600 90 G4 2,000 110 G5 2,500 130 Trips shorter than 8 hours get half the daily allowance. If meals are provided by the host or included in a conference fee, the allowance is reduced by 25 % for each main meal provided (breakfast, lunch, dinner). The allowance is not paid for days of personal leave taken during a trip.

sections.title: 7. Receipts
sections.summary: Original receipts or tax invoices are required for every expense above INR 500, except the daily allowance.
sections.text: Original receipts or tax invoices are required for every expense above INR 500, except the daily allowance. Lost receipts: a self-declaration is accepted up to INR 2,000 per trip; above that the expense is not reimbursed. Receipts must show the GST number of the supplier where applicable.

sections.title: 8. Not reimbursed
sections.summary: Alcohol, minibar, laundry for trips shorter than 4 nights, personal entertainment, traffic fines, upgrades bought by the employee, travel insurance bought separately (the company policy covers all business trips), and ex
sections.text: Alcohol, minibar, laundry for trips shorter than 4 nights, personal entertainment, traffic fines, upgrades bought by the employee, travel insurance bought separately (the company policy covers all business trips), and expenses for accompanying family members.

sections.title: 9. Advances
sections.summary: An advance of up to 80 % of the estimated trip cost may be requested for trips longer than 3 days or for international trips.
sections.text: An advance of up to 80 % of the estimated trip cost may be requested for trips longer than 3 days or for international trips. The advance must be settled within 15 days of return; unsettled advances are recovered from the next salary.

sections.title: 10. Mileage
sections.summary: Use of a personal car for business travel is reimbursed at INR 12 per km, and a personal two wheeler at INR 5 per km, for distances above 20 km per day.
sections.text: Use of a personal car for business travel is reimbursed at INR 12 per km, and a personal two-wheeler at INR 5 per km, for distances above 20 km per day. Tolls and parking are reimbursed at actuals with receipts.
